integrity: The finite theorem is replayed by two independent exhaustive enumeration directions: pair-first over all totals through thirteen and union-first over every thirteen-voter union and all componentwise splits.
scientific_limitations: The census covers three candidates at the minimal total electorate size thirteen and requires unique IRV outcomes at every stage. It counts anonymous profiles and unordered constituency pairs, not individually labeled voter partitions.
title: Complete minimal reinforcement-pair census for three-candidate instant runoff
